ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL) disclosed a visit from the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) on October 21, 2026, as part of an industry-wide review concerning the HSN Code applicability for imported bulk Scotch. While ABDL currently reports no immediate financial or operational impact and no specific violation has been alleged, this regulatory scrutiny presents a material red flag regarding potential future liabilities from customs duty reclassification for its core imported raw material.
